mapper.select:
SELECT RESULT_ID, LOT_ID, ITEM_ID, RESULT_TYPE, REASON, EDITED_YN, REG_DT FROM PROD_RESULT
LOT_ID LIKE '%' || #{lotId} || '%'
ORDER BY RESULT_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROD_RESULT (LOT_ID, ITEM_ID, RESULT_TYPE, REASON) VALUES (#{lotId}, #{itemId}, #{resultType}, #{reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE PROD_RESULT SET RESULT_TYPE = #{resultType}, REASON = #{reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EDITED_YN = 'Y' WHERE RESULT_ID = #{resultId}
